name: Gyro garden flyer
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}if(m.x===undefined){m.x=s.x;m.z=s.z;m.hi=0;}var a=0.22*Math.max(0,t-2),run=t>2?1:0;var tx=m.x+3*Math.sin(a),tz=m.z+3*(Math.cos(a)-1),tvx=run*0.66*Math.cos(a),tvz=-run*0.66*Math.sin(a);var ax=cl(0.45*(tx-s.x)+1.3*(tvx-s.vx)-run*0.1452*Math.sin(a),0.9),az=cl(0.45*(tz-s.z)+1.3*(tvz-s.vz)-run*0.1452*Math.cos(a),0.9);var q=s.rotation,x=q[0],y=q[1],z=q[2],w=q[3];var lx=(1-2*(y*y+z*z))*ax+2*(x*z-y*w)*az,lz=2*(x*z+y*w)*ax+(1-2*(x*x+y*y))*az;var g=s.gravity,gy=s.gyroscope,G=Math.sqrt(g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1]+g[2]*g[2]);var pitch=Math.atan2(g[2],-g[1]),roll=Math.atan2(-g[0],-g[1]);var pd=cl(lz/G,0.24),rd=cl(-lx/G,0.24);var mx=20*(pd-pitch)-8*gy[0],mz=20*(rd-roll)-8*gy[2];var hy=3+0.4*Math.sin(0.3*t),eh=hy-s.y;m.hi=cl(m.hi+eh*s.dt,2);var ay=cl(3*eh-3*s.vy+0.3*m.hi,4);var base=s.mass*(G+ay)/(4*Math.max(0.6,s.up));function jet(f){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,f/20));}return {A:jet(base-mz/2),S:jet(base+mz/2),D:jet(base-mx/2),F:jet(base+mx/2)};}

name: Channel catamaran — feedback patrol
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}function wrap(v){return Math.atan2(Math.sin(v),Math.cos(v));}if(m.x===undefined){m.x=s.x;m.z=s.z;m.k=0;m.i=0;m.stuck=0;m.back=0;}if(t<1.5)return {};if(t<m.back)return {Q:0.4,W:0.4};var contact=false;for(var j=0;j<s.touching.length;j++)if(s.touching[j])contact=true;var speed=Math.sqrt(s.vx*s.vx+s.vz*s.vz);m.stuck=contact&&speed<0.2?m.stuck+s.dt:0;if(m.stuck>0.8){m.back=t+1.8;m.k=(m.k+1)%4;m.stuck=0;m.i=0;return {Q:0.4,W:0.4};}var points=[[0,5],[4,5],[4,-5],[0,-5]],p=points[m.k];var dx=m.x+p[0]-s.x,dz=m.z+p[1]-s.z,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);if(d<1.2){m.k=(m.k+1)%4;m.i=0;p=points[m.k];dx=m.x+p[0]-s.x;dz=m.z+p[1]-s.z;d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);}var q=s.rotation,yaw=Math.atan2(2*(q[0]*q[2]+q[1]*q[3]),1-2*(q[0]*q[0]+q[1]*q[1]));var e=wrap(Math.atan2(dx,dz)-yaw),v=s.localVelocity[2],want=Math.min(1.5,0.65*d)*Math.max(0,Math.cos(e));if(Math.abs(e)>1.1)want=0;var ev=want-v;m.i=cl(m.i+ev*s.dt,2);var drive=cl(0.24*want+0.35*ev+0.05*m.i,0.62),turn=cl(0.85*e-0.95*s.gyroscope[1],0.7);if(s.up<0.85)drive=0;var l=cl(drive+turn,1),rr=cl(drive-turn,1),out={};out[l>=0?'A':'Q']=Math.abs(l);out[rr>=0?'S':'W']=Math.abs(rr);return out;}

name: Strideglass — continuous contact trot
source: function(t,s,m,r){if(m.p===undefined){m.p=0;m.a=0;m.t=t;m.hit=0;m.x=s.x;m.z=s.z;m.d=1;m.turn=t;}var H=[5,8,11,14],P=[6,9,12,15],F=[7,10,13,16],hn=['Q','O','E','F'],hp=['A','K','R','G'],pn=['W','P','D','Y'],pp=['S','L','T','H'],out={},p=m.p,u=t-m.t,d=m.d,lift=true,swing=true,land=true,q=s.rotation;function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}var yaw=Math.atan2(2*(q[0]*q[2]+q[3]*q[1]),1-2*(q[0]*q[0]+q[1]*q[1])),want=cl(-d*0.1*(s.x-m.x),0.25),corr=cl(0.5*(yaw-want)+0.18*s.gyroscope[1],0.18);for(var i=0;i<4;i++){var active=(i===0||i===3)===(m.a===0),contact=(s.touching[P[i]]||s.touching[F[i]])&&s.positions[F[i]][1]<s.ground+0.85,hip=0,knee=-0.8,side=i%2===0?-1:1;if(active){if(s.angles[P[i]]<0.49)lift=false;if(d*s.angles[H[i]]> -0.46)swing=false;if(!contact)land=false;if(p<2){knee=1;if((p===1||s.angles[P[i]]>0.28)&&d*s.angles[H[i]]> -0.48)hip=-d;}else knee=-1;}else if(contact&&d*s.angles[H[i]]<0.48){hip=d*0.75+side*corr;}if(t<0.35){knee=-1;hip=0;m.t=t;}if(s.up<0.95)hip*=0.5;if(hip>0)out[hp[i]]=cl(hip,1);else if(hip<0)out[hn[i]]=-cl(hip,1);if(knee>0)out[pp[i]]=knee;else out[pn[i]]=-knee;}m.hit=land?m.hit+s.dt:0;var done=p===0?((u>0.23&&lift)||u>0.4):p===1?((u>0.12&&swing)||u>0.55):((u>0.2&&m.hit>0.035)||u>0.42);if(done&&t>0.35){m.p=(p+1)%3;m.t=t;m.hit=0;if(m.p===0){m.a=1-m.a;var dz=s.z-m.z,nd=d;if(dz>16)nd=-1;else if(dz< -8)nd=1;else if(t-m.turn>18)nd=-d;if(nd!==d){m.d=nd;m.turn=t;}}}return out;}

name: Mooncalf — coordinated hinged knees
source: function(t,s,m,r){function cl(v,a){return Math.max(-a,Math.min(a,v));}function phi(b){return Math.atan2(1.5*Math.sin(b),0.5+1.5*Math.cos(b));}if(m.p===undefined){m.p=0;m.a=0;m.t=t;m.hit=0;m.st=[0,0,0,0];m.x=s.x;m.z=s.z;m.d=1;m.turn=t;}var H=[5,9,13,17],K=[6,10,14,18],F=[8,12,16,20],hn=['Q','O','E','F'],hp=['A','K','R','G'],kn=['W','P','D','Y'],kp=['S','L','T','H'],out={},p=m.p,u=t-m.t,d=m.d,lift=true,swung=true,land=true,q=s.rotation,yaw=Math.atan2(2*(q[0]*q[2]+q[3]*q[1]),1-2*(q[0]*q[0]+q[1]*q[1])),corr=cl(0.45*(yaw+cl(d*0.08*(s.x-m.x),0.2))+0.15*s.gyroscope[1],0.1);for(var i=0;i<4;i++){var active=(i===0||i===3)===(m.a===0),b=s.angles[K[i]],h=s.angles[H[i]],contact=(s.touching[F[i]]||s.touching[F[i]-1])&&s.positions[F[i]][1]<s.ground+0.85,bt=0,ht=h,hip=0,side=i%2===0?-1:1;if(active){if(b<0.99)lift=false;if(d*(h+phi(b))> -0.27)swung=false;if(!contact||Math.abs(b)>0.08)land=false;bt=p<2?1.05:0;ht=(p===0?m.st[i]:-d*0.3)-phi(b);}else{if(contact&&d*h<0.32)hip=d*0.26+side*corr;}var knee=cl(4*(bt-b)-0.04*s.rates[K[i]],1);if(active){var dp=(2.25+0.75*Math.cos(b))/(2.5+1.5*Math.cos(b));hip=cl(4*(ht-h)-dp*s.rates[K[i]]/3,1);}if(t<0.4){hip=cl(-4*h,1);knee=cl(-4*b,1);m.t=t;}if(s.up<0.96)hip*=0.6;if(hip>0)out[hp[i]]=hip;else out[hn[i]]=-hip;if(knee>0)out[kp[i]]=knee;else out[kn[i]]=-knee;}m.hit=land?m.hit+s.dt:0;var done=p===0?((u>0.3&&lift)||u>0.6):p===1?((u>0.2&&swung)||u>0.6):((u>0.3&&m.hit>0.04)||u>0.65);if(done&&t>0.4){m.p=(p+1)%3;m.t=t;m.hit=0;if(m.p===0){m.a=1-m.a;for(var j=0;j<4;j++)m.st[j]=cl(s.angles[H[j]]+phi(s.angles[K[j]]),0.33);var dz=s.z-m.z,nd=d;if(dz>16)nd=-1;else if(dz< -8)nd=1;else if(t-m.turn>18)nd=-d;if(nd!==d){m.d=nd;m.turn=t;}}}return out;}

source: function(t,s,m,r){/* 66-part alloy revision; tray x6/7 y11 z0..2; supports z-1. World crate45 remains160.163,-3.898,-11.253. */const c=(v,a=-1,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));if(m.p===undefined){m.p=0;m.at=t;m.x=s.x;m.y=s.y;m.prev=s.positions[25].slice();m.hold=0;}let h=s.positions[25],dt=s.dt||1/60,v=h.map((a,i)=>(a-m.prev[i])/dt);m.prev=h.slice();let q={},mag=s.magnets[25],age=t-m.at;function go(p){m.p=p;m.at=t;m.hold=0;}function out(n,p,a){q[a>=0?p:n]=Math.abs(c(a));}function lift(y){let u=c((h[1]-y)*1.4+v[1]*.32,-.75,.75);let d=(s.angles[17]-s.angles[18])*.35;out('W','S',u-d);out('E','D',u+d);}function reach(x,cap){let u=c((x-h[0])*1.5-v[0]*.38,-cap,cap);out('O','K',u);out('Q','A',u);out('U','J',u);}function retract(){[21,22,23].forEach((i,j)=>out(['O','Q','U'][j],['K','A','J'][j],c(-3*s.angles[i],-.55,.55)));}function hoist(){out('W','S',c(-3*s.angles[17],-.6,.6));out('E','D',c(-3*s.angles[18],-.6,.6));}if(age>14&&m.p<6)go(99);if(m.p>=2&&m.p<=4&&!mag.attached)go(99);if(m.p===99)return mag.attached?{F:1}:{R:1};if(m.p===0){q.R=1;retract();lift(m.y-7.5);if(Math.abs(h[1]-(m.y-7.5))<.08&&Math.abs(v[1])<.15)go(1);}else if(m.p===1){q.F=1;lift(m.y-7.5);reach(m.x+5.1,.24);if(mag.attached){m.pick=h.slice();go(2);}}else if(m.p===2){q.F=1;lift(m.y-7.5);retract();if(s.angles[21]+s.angles[22]+s.angles[23]<.03&&age>.8)go(3);}else if(m.p===3){q.F=1;retract();hoist();if(s.angles[17]+s.angles[18]<.012&&Math.abs(v[1])<.12&&age>1)go(4);}else if(m.p===4){q.F=1;hoist();reach(m.x+5.02,.09);let ok=Math.abs(h[0]-m.x-5.02)<.06&&Math.abs(v[0])<.07&&h[1]>s.positions[34][1]+1.12;m.hold=ok?m.hold+dt:0;if(m.hold>.7)go(5);}else if(m.p===5){q.R=1;hoist();if(age>1.5)go(6);}else{q.R=1;hoist();retract();}return q;}
